contradiction_resolution: The finding has no recorded claim-level contradictions and does not conflict with CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with FND-0097: vanishing of the relative sheaf R^1s_*End(F) does not eliminate global extension classes arising from base cohomology, such as H^1(B,s_*Hom(L_4,L_5)), and therefore does not force F to split globally. It complements rather than duplicates FND-0097, which concerns the canonical filtered CE reduction and possible global nonsplitting, and FND-0099, which proves different higher-direct-image and evaluation vanishings for W_4. No merge is warranted. The original single-engine adversarial-review evidence is independently replaced by the fibre calculation and primary-reference base-change argument, so the conditional lemma should be promoted to corroborated status with the stated hypotheses.

scope.base_scope: The cited argument applies directly for scheme bases. For an algebraic or Deligne-Mumford stack base, the same conclusion holds when s is representable and proper and F is finite locally free, by pulling back to a scheme atlas and descending the zero quasi-coherent sheaf.
exclusions: It does not assert or imply a global splitting of F over B.
It does not establish the CE evaluation-failure locus, its Fitting scheme structure, or Tate-type conclusions.
scope.generality: The calculation also works for any constant consecutive splitting type O(a) direct-sum O(a+1); the campaign application is the balanced genus-six tetragonal type (4,5).
hypotheses: s:P^1_B->B is the proper relative projective line
F is a rank-two finite locally free sheaf on P^1_B
for every geometric point b of B, F_b is isomorphic to O(4) direct-sum O(5)
scope.proof_scope: Fibrewise, End(F_b) is O direct-sum O direct-sum O(1) direct-sum O(-1), whose four summands have vanishing H^1 on P^1. Since relative dimension is one, top-degree cohomology commutes with arbitrary base change and R^1 s_* End(F) is finite type; its geometric fibres vanish, so Nakayama gives the asserted sheaf vanishing.
